name: Verse and Worse Karaoke with Aashish Paul
description:
**About the Event:**

Verse and Worse Karaoke with Aashish Paul - Dramatic duets, forgotten lyrics, guilty pleasure anthems - all welcome here. Hosted by Aashish Paul at The Humming Tree. No judgment, just good music and louder singalongs 😎

Join us this Tuesday!

**The Humming Tree:**

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: Live Urban Sketching Bootcamp - Workshop Series
description:
*Learn how to draw on location and maintain a sketchbook with this 4 part live drawing bootcamp! Each session will begin with an instructional segment, learning an aspect of life drawing and building skills, followed by a live location demo and a practice session for participants. Instructional session will be conducted at Atta Galatta, Indiranagar, followed by the demo and drawing session at a different location in the area each week.*

*Each week we tackle something different -*

*Session 1 : Drawing Nature and Organic shapes.*

*Session 2 : Understanding Perspective and architecture.*

*Session 3: Drawing people.*

*Session 4: Capturing Light and Colour.*

*Dates : Saturdays, 9AM-12PM (3hrs) on 14th Nov, 21st Nov, 28th Nov & 5th December.*

Join us for the entire bootcamp or for a single session!

name: Build-A Being
description:
Somewhere between sculpture, storytelling and a little bit of absurdity lies Build-A-Being.

We're setting aside an afternoon at Mudnoma to explore character-making through clay. Think unusual proportions, strange expressions, unexpected forms and creatures that probably shouldn't exist (but will).

A workshop for adults who enjoy making things without needing a reason to make them useful!

name: An Hour of Stillness - An immersive sound experience
description:
Somewhere between the demands of the day and the things waiting for tomorrow, there is a little space to pause.

Join Sri for an immersive 60-minute sound experience with Himalayan singing bowls, crystal bowls, handpan, ocean drum and gong.

Through layers of sound, moments of quiet and a gentle return to the present, you'll have an hour to simply listen.

There's nothing to learn, no experience required and nothing you need to achieve.

Just come as you are. Get comfortable. Listen.

**What to expect**

- A gentle arrival and grounding
- An immersive journey through live instrumental sounds
- Moments of quiet and stillness
- Time to return slowly before the session closes

**Who is this for?**

Anyone looking to step away from the demands of everyday life and make a little room for themselves. No prior meditation or sound experience is needed.

name: 7Paintings - The Art of Dining
description:
• 7 Paintings is a globally acclaimed German dining concept, making its debut in India for the first time in Bengaluru.

• An immersive dining experience that brings together art, technology, storytelling and fine dining in a unique, interactive format.

• Guests embark on a 2.5-hour journey featuring a seven-course dinner, with each course inspired by iconic masterpieces brought to life through mesmerising projections on the dining table.

• Located at Gladia Brewery & Kitchen on Sarjapur Main Road, the experience is strictly by advance reservation only, with no walk-ins permitted.

name: Table92 - Supper Club
description:
Table 92 is an intimate home-dining experience where food becomes a reason to slow down, connect, and have conversations.

Hosted in a cozy home in Koramangala, Bangalore, each gathering welcomes just six guests for a thoughtfully curated two-hour experience. Over a five-course meal, you’ll share stories, perspectives, laughter, and perhaps leave with a few new friends.

We host both brunch and supper editions across the month, each with a different menu and mood.

What’s Included

• A curated 5-course meal

• A two-hour intimate dining experience

• Intimate group of only 6-8 guests

• Shared dining and conversation experience

• Vegetarian and non-vegetarian options available

Good to Know

• Exact venue details will be shared after booking.

• Please inform us of any dietary restrictions in advance.

• Instagram: @table92

Come hungry. Leave with stories.

name: Potato Head Bali X Brine
description:
Bali docks at Brine for one night.

The bar: Akbar, who runs beverage R&D at Potato Head, takes over our bar. He works root-to-flower, wasting nothing, and he's bringing four drinks from Bali: Barong Zombie, Papa Paan, Kookaburra and Asinan Margarita.

The decks: Dita of Klymax Discotheque plays proto-house, 90s breaks, Balearic and beyond. She's played Dekmantel, Panorama Bar and Boiler Room, and on the 28th she plays Brine.

The Kitchen: A special limited menu for the night: karaage, burgers, char siu rice, and noodles

Cruise over for a good one!
